rhea.title: Lady
rhea.name: Rhea
rhea.backstory: Once the archbishop of a great church in the warring continents beyond the southern straits, and something far older than any archbishop. Rhea is serene, maternal and terrifying in equal measure. She claims she is here to tend the faithful.

lethe.backstory: A cat laguz warrior from the warring continents beyond the southern straits who distrusts humans on principle and Sam in particular, at first. She guards the door because someone competent has to.

panne.name: Panne
panne.backstory: The last of a rabbit shapeshifter people from the warring continents beyond the southern straits, Panne trusts very few humans and says so. The ones she does trust, she would die for.

design.features: long lop brown rabbit ears draping over her shoulders, a fluffy tail and dark facial markings

eirika.backstory: A princess who led her people through war and rebuilt a kingdom from ashes, Eirika is kind, brave and forever apologizing for things that were not her fault. She came to Hollowmere on a pilgrimage, and found the work warm and honest. She still stands as though a crown were on her head.

design.accessories: a slender rapier at her hip

byleth.backstory: A mercenary who became a professor almost by accident, Byleth speaks little, notices everything and is quietly very good at both teaching and killing. She arrived in Hollowmere looking for work that did not involve a battlefield. She shows her feelings so rarely that a small smile is a gift.

design.accessories: an ornate chained sword at her hip

celica.name: Celica
celica.title: Princess
celica.backstory: A princess who left the safety of a convent and a kingdom to find her missing friend, Celica faced every hardship with a smile and a blessing. She came to Hollowmere on the same hopeful errand and decided that helping people was as good a quest as any. She prays before every shift and means every word.

design.accessories: a golden circlet and a silver-tipped staff

tiki.title: Lady
tiki.name: Tiki
tiki.backstory: Known in her homeland across the southern straits as the Voice of the Divine Dragon, Tiki has slept away millennia and outlived almost everyone she ever loved. Waking in Hollowmere was the first surprise in a thousand years that made her smile, and she lingers in the lounge just to be around warm, noisy mortal lives.

design.accessories: a golden tiara with a red teardrop gem and a gold collar-necklace

sig_tiki.label: Oracle's vestments

nowi.note: Fellow manaketes who understand how fast mortal centuries fly by.

unique.name: Voice of the Divine
unique.desc: Three millennia of gentle poise soothe any room she enters.

nowi.name: Nowi
nowi.backstory: A thousand-year-old manakete from the warring continents beyond the southern straits who refuses to act her age because being solemn is boring. Nowi treats the dance floor like a playground, hoards shiny trinkets in her room, and is much wiser about people's hearts than she ever lets on.

sig_nowi.prompt: a pink and purple ruffled bikini-style top with a detached collar and capelet, short white and gold puffed shorts, and tall purple-and-pink striped boots

tiki.note: Fellow manaketes who understand how fast mortal centuries fly by.

tharja.note: Nowi isn't scared of her hexes at all, which Tharja secretly appreciates.

unique.name: Eternal Playfulness
unique.desc: A thousand years of boundless energy keep the crowd smiling.

tharja.name: Tharja
tharja.backstory: A dark mage from the desert kingdom of Plegia across the southern straits, Tharja mutters hexes under her breath, collects hair clippings for reasons she won't explain, and stares at Sam from behind pillars. Beneath the gloom and the sheer black mesh is a woman whose devotion, once fixed on someone, is absolute and slightly terrifying.

design.accessories: a gold coin-trimmed headband and a dark tome
design.expression: a gloomy, obsessive stare that softens into a sly smile

sig_tharja.label: Plegian dark mage

nowi.note: Nowi isn't scared of her hexes at all, which Tharja secretly appreciates.

lucina.backstory: A princess from a ruined future who crossed time itself to save her father's kingdom, Lucina takes every duty like a vow and has terrible, earnest taste in fashion. With no apocalypse left to prevent in Hollowmere, she is learning how to live an ordinary life—one awkward smile at a time.

design.features: the circular Brand of the Exalt in her left eye
design.accessories: the exalted sword Falchion at her hip
